verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it re-runs automatically on every PR update and reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback. That covers the push-triggered re-review and the de-duplication parts of the story. One community user reported getting the exact same original recommendation again after arguing against a fix and reverting it, though the report mixes Bugbot with Claude, so it is not treated as a clear contradiction. missing for 10: documented incremental (new-commits-only) diff scoping, explicit tracking or resolution of fixed issues across pushes, and independent corroboration that old comments are not repeated.

support.subject: As a developer, pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review that tracks what was fixed instead of repeating old comments

citations.quote: Runs automatic reviews on every PR update
reads connected PR comments (top-level and inline) to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback
